name: sgs/cart
title: SGS Cart
description: WooCommerce mini-cart: live item-count badge plus an optional flyout (disclosure) or drawer (dialog) panel with AJAX add/qty/remove via the WooCommerce Store API. Hydrates client-side to bypass full-page cache.

sgs._comment_mediaElements: Rule 37-media-no-handroll fix. The mini-cart item thumbnail (WooCommerce product image, hydrated client-side by panel-render.js/item-row-template.js from the Store API) now routes its object-fit through the shared media-element atom layer instead of a style.css literal. This is a NEW client control — no pre-existing object-fit picker on this block. render.php (always PHP-rendered, even before JS hydration) emits the atom's --sgs-media-object-fit custom property scoped to the block wrapper; item-row-template.js appends the shared .sgs-media-el marker class to the thumbnail it builds at runtime — the custom property inherits down regardless of when that element is added to the DOM. style.css no longer hardcodes object-fit on .sgs-cart__item-thumb, relying on assets/css/media-atoms/object-fit.css's cover fallback (identical default).

wrapper.label: Cart wrapper
wrapper._note: supports.color is explicitly {background:false,text:false} and spacing.padding is false — layout is scoped to margin only (every other layout member is a real gap, not a missing declaration).

icon.label: Cart icon
icon._note: iconSize is a real attribute but is not a css:font-size (sets width/height, not text size) — no cluster member exists, so it is an honest ORPHAN (FR-35-4). `css:stroke` (D636/D644 icon/SVG gradient mechanism) explicit-mapped to iconColourGradient, added 2026-08-16 (Builder 4) — non-empty wins over iconColour's flat currentColor paint at render time (helpers-svg-gradient.php). iconColourHover/iconColourHoverGradient (2026-09-06, colour-conformance closeout) mirror sgs/icon's own hover states shape exactly — resolved via sgs_icon_gradient_css() on .sgs-cart__trigger:hover.

badge.label: Item-count badge
badge._note: badgeColour/badgeTextColour do not follow the default {prefix}{suffix} convention — explicit attrMap required per ROLLOUT REQUIREMENT 1. Gradient siblings added 2026-09-04: badgeColourGradient paints a hand-built ::after layer (NOT sgs_block_background_layer_css() — the badge is already position:absolute, which that helper would silently override), freeing the element's own background-image for badgeTextColourGradient's background-clip:text.

panel.label: Mini-cart panel
panel._note: FR-36-19 Phase 2 — the flyout/drawer panel surface. panelBg/panelTextColour do not follow {prefix}{suffix} — explicit attrMap. Only rendered when displayMode is flyout|drawer. Gradient siblings added 2026-09-04, same hand-built ::after reasoning as the badge element above (the panel's own --flyout/--drawer modifiers declare position:absolute/fixed, at the same specificity a uid-scoped sgs_block_background_layer_css() rule would carry).

iconColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the cart icon's stroke instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over iconColour at render time (D636/D644).

iconColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the cart icon's stroke on hover instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over iconColourHover at render time.
